scope: Mechanical consistency check of every markdown file against the evidence it cites. Does not judge prose.
why: A manual review missed the root README and RECOVERY_STATUS, both of which described a two-day-old state at the front door of the repository. Eyeballing 57 files does not stay true.
limits: Checks numbers, npm commands, relative links and stale branch claims. Narrative that is merely out of date still needs a human reader.
